newsitem.title: USA: Virginia First Q1 Sept 30 net down.
newsitem.headline: Virginia First Q1 Sept 30 net down.

text.p: (Dollars in Thousands Except per Share Data)

NOTE: Net earnings for the first fiscal quarter reflect a one-time pre-tax charge of $3,149,000 to pay for a special assessment to recapitalize the Savings Association Insurance Fund maintained by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation ("FDIC"). On an after-tax basis, the FDIC charge was $1,954,000, or $.34 per share. Without the FDIC charge, Virginia First's earnings for the first fiscal quarter would have been $2,150,000, or $.37 per share, an increase of 2.2 percent, or $.01 per share, from the same quarter in fiscal year 1996.

The new law also authorizes the FDIC to reduce insurance premiums after December 31, 1996 to reflect the recapitalized insurance fund. Virginia First expects that its annualized insurance premiums will be approximately $940,000 lower on a pre-tax basis than they would be without the special assessment law. In addition, future growth in deposits will be subject to the lower statutory premiums.
